generation.scope: All smooth septic point graphs with point fibers are explicitly classified by eight coefficients of three canonical quadrics, subject only to smooth complete intersection. The residual action is a three-dimensional effective torus and a swap. All are bielliptic, their isomorphism classes have dimension five, generic period two, and all period-one specializations are decided by changing the sign of the mixed coefficient and testing that action. Two smooth examples and their full finite Frobenius ranks are checked.

open_mathematics: Pass from smooth to singular or reducible genus-one quartic curves and from integral smooth septics to singular Gorenstein components; also continue the general finite-point and positive-fiber coverage problem.
